scope: Every link reaches this device at harness.tail.ts.net. The ground station has to reach that name too — on another machine, scan a link's QR code from there.

targets.label: RTSP · QGroundControl, Mission Planner or VLC
targets.hint: QGroundControl: Application Settings → Video → Source "RTSP Video Stream" → paste. Mission Planner: right-click the HUD → Video → Set RTSP Source.

targets.label: WHEP · Aircast QGroundControl, a browser or OBS
targets.hint: Browser: open the link. OBS: Media Source → paste.

targets.label: UDP · MAVLink
targets.hint: QGroundControl: Application Settings → Comm Links → Add → Type UDP → Server: this host and port. Mission Planner: pick UDPCl and enter it.

fallback.label: Web players and Safari
fallback.hint: When nothing else will play. Reaches the device over your network or Tailscale.
